page.overview:
Who is Tholote B'Leph?

Tholote B'Leph was a politician who served as an opposition leader on the planet Ter Abbes during the reign of the New Republic. The Yuuzhan Vong agent Nom Anor hired Goran Beviin to assassinate B'Leph, whose death resulted in a year-long civil war.

During the reign of the New Republic, Tholote B'Leph was involved in politics on Ter Abbes, a grim industrial planet located off the main Perlemian Trade Route While B'Leph was in power, he accepted bribes and became known for his excessive generosity in awarding government contracts. He later became the leader of the political opposition on Ter Abbes, though he did not abandon his corrupt practices.

By the fifth month of 24 ABY, Nom Anor, an infiltrator of the extragalactic Yuuzhan Vong species, had spent nearly two decades spying on the inhabitants of the galaxy and destabilizing its political structure. In pursuit of these goals, he decided to incite riots across the planet Ter Abbes by assassinating their opposition leader, Tholote B'Leph. As part of his plan, Nom Anor intended to hire a Mandalorian warrior to evaluate the effectiveness of their methods and determine how useful they might prove for the Yuuzhan Vong's upcoming invasion.

On Nar Shaddaa, Nom Anor, operating under the alias «Udelen», met with the Mandalorian Goran Beviin to arrange the assassination of the politician Tholote B'Leph. Anor revealed that he wanted the politician assassinated a few days before the next month's elections on Ter Abbes. In exchange, he offered one hundred thousand credits and promised that, if he was satisfied with the results, he would provide Beviin and his Mandalorian comrades with additional lucrative contracts. For Beviin, interfering in politics was work better suited to spies and carried far more potential trouble than he could handle alone. He knew that the assassination of the opposition leader would inevitably spark riots across the planet and briefly considered whether intimidating B'Leph by breaking his fingers, breaking one of his legs, or simply roughing him up would suffice. However, «Udelen» made it clear that he wanted nothing less than Tholote B'Leph's death. Despite his reservations, the promise of a substantial reward ultimately convinced the Mandalorian to accept the contract. Although Beviin was unaware of «Udelen»'s true motives, he concluded that his secretive employer was most likely involved in planning a coup on Ter Abbes.
